title: Sequential Strategic Classification with Multi-Stage Selective Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2605.04202v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Strategic classification studies the problem where self-interested individuals or agents manipulate their response to obtain favorable decision outcomes made by classifiers, typically turning to dishonest actions when they are less costly than genuine efforts. Prior works have demonstrated a fundamental inability to get out of this conundrum by only focusing on the design of a classifier. We note that prior work also heavily focuses on either one-shot settings or repeated interaction with the same classifier. Real-world decision making is often multi-stage, involving a sequence of potentially different classifiers as an agent progresses. This paper introduces a sequential, stochastic, multi-stage model of strategic classification, by capturing how agents adapt their behavior, through improvement actions (enhancing both observable features and true attributes) and gaming actions (enhancing only observable features), over multiple leve

translated_title: 基于多阶段选择性分类器的序贯策略性分类
translated_abstract: 策略性分类研究的是自利的个人或智能体通过操纵自身响应来获取分类器有利决策结果的问题，当不诚实行为的代价低于付出真实努力时，他们通常会采取不诚实的行动。先前的研究已经表明，仅仅专注于分类器的设计无法从根本上摆脱这一困境。我们还注意到，先前的工作也大多集中在一锤子定音的单次决策设置，或与同一分类器的重复交互上。然而，现实世界的决策过程往往是多阶段的，随着智能体不断推进，会涉及一系列可能不同的分类器。本文引入了一个序贯的、随机的、多阶段的策略性分类模型，刻画了智能体如何通过改进行为（同时提升可观测特征和真实属性）与投机行为（仅提升可观测特征），在多个阶段逐步调整自身行为。
tldr: 本文提出了一种序贯、随机、多阶段的策略性分类新模型，刻画了智能体通过改进行为与投机行为在多个阶段面对不同分类器时逐步调整策略的过程，突破了以往研究仅关注单次决策或与单一分类器重复交互的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a sequential, stochastic, multi-stage model of strategic classification that captures how agents adapt their behavior through improvement and gaming actions across multiple stages with potentially different classifiers, overcoming prior work's focus on one-shot settings or repeated interactions with a single classifier.
